result.citation: San Diego Mun. Code § 98.0704 (Ord. O-21647 N.S., amended by O-21769 N.S.)
result.citation_basis: § 98.0704: D073; Ord. O-21647 N.S.: D073 (history note to § 98.0704, added 5-25-2023, effective 6-24-2023); O-21769 N.S.: D073 (history note to § 98.0704, amended 2-27-2024, effective 3-28-2024)
result.official_quote: A landlord shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause. For purposes of this Division, just cause includes at-fault just cause and no-fault just cause.
